messages:
Ana Rivera: Quick sync 1  SkyForge wants joint marketplace tile, a co-authored blog, and a press blurb to go live together. Ops window suggestions?
Mike Chen: Ops suggests a late-afternoon window for APAC overlap: 14:00-16:00 UTC. Lower traffic risk. Thoughts?
Amir (SkyForge): 14:00-16:00 UTC works for us. Wed need embargo lifted 13:30 UTC so our comms team can schedule pickup.
Julie Park: Design asks  we need hero art, 1 localized screenshot (JP), and 1 mobile mock by noon PT tomorrow. @Mike where will partner assets land?
Mike Chen: I'll place final assets in the marketplace bucket by 20:00 PT: https://drive.redwood.co/partners/skyforge/assets
Tom Reilly: Ops high-level run (compact):
```
13:00 UTC - infra sanity checks (DB replicas + certs)
13:30 UTC - internal readiness call (10m)
13:45 UTC - decrease DNS TTL + CDN sweep
13:30 UTC - embargo lift (partner distribution)
14:00 UTC - publish landing + marketplace tile + blog
14:05 UTC - smoke tests (signup flow, marketplace API, CI webhook)
14:30 UTC - monitor metrics + postmortem standby
```
Sree Nandakumar: SI onboarding note  Systems Integrator "NorthStar" needs a dedicated test org and rotated API keys by 12:30 UTC. Tom, can infra handle provisioning before 12:00 UTC?
Tom Reilly: Yes, provisioning scheduled for 10:30 UTC and I'll paste the run logs into the runbook page.
Ana Rivera: Who will own final blog copy and the partner quote? We have co-draft v1 in HackMD.
Julie Park: I'll shepherd the blog to final. @Amir please send a 2-sentence quote (20-40 words) by EOD PT. Also locking CTA: "Deploy SkyForge on Redwood 1 Start a free trial."
Amir (SkyForge): Quote and legal-approved blurb incoming by 18:00 PT. CTA fine.
Mike Chen: Proposed routes: /partners/skyforge and /skyforge-docs for guides. Approve?
Ana Rivera: Approve. Tom, add UTM template and make sure referral headers are intact for marketplace analytics.
Tom Reilly: Will add UTM rules and pre-cache the landing with a 30m warm-up. Also will prepare a one-click revert script for the listing.
Sree Nandakumar: Rollback snippet for runbook (brief):
```
1) point /partners/skyforge -> static holding page
2) call POST /marketplace/v1/listings/{id}/disable
3) open incident if >3% error rate and notify partner channel
```
Mike Chen: Need launch coverage: 2 infra, 1 comms, 1 partner PM between 13:30-15:30 UTC. Volunteers?
Julie Park: I'll take comms 13:20-15:20 UTC.
Tom Reilly: Taking infra primary 11:00-13:30 UTC then handoff to Sree.
Sree Nandakumar: I'll be infra secondary 13:30-15:30 UTC.
Ana Rivera: @Mike please add roster to the calendar and create the runbook stub: https://handbook.redwood.co/launches/skyforge-marketplace-runbook (include mobile numbers).
Mike Chen: Calendar invite sent. Runbook created and initial checklist uploaded.
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: "Pre-launch sanity" 12:45 UTC -> #ops-bridge
Ana Rivera: Any legal/compliance holds?
Julie Park: Legal reviewed the co-release terms; flagged minor trademark usage. Id loop legal into the publish thread.
Amir (SkyForge): Partner-side checklist green except for the trademark tweak. We'll be on-call during 13:30-15:30 UTC to verify regional landing content.
Mike Chen: Consolidated actions:
- Julie: finalize blog + legal note (today)
- Mike: upload assets + calendar + runbook (today)
- Tom: provisioning + CDN prewarm + revert script (day-of morning)
- Sree: rollback snippet + SI coordination (today)
- Amir: partner quote + trademark confirmation (by 18:00 PT)
Ana Rivera: I'll post final go/no-go at 11:00 UTC day-of. If no objections we'll proceed. :rocket:
